I didn't build this case. This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent it, and a substitute would misrepresent the case. I checked the available models with `list_models`, and they are only generic steady-state units. Those are mixers, splitters, heaters, flashes, pumps, valves, reactors, feed sources and product sinks.

What is missing:
- **ProductionPad, Transport, StorageTank, WaterTreatment, TemporalLink and OptimizationObjective:** none of these exist as unit models. The mixer and product-sink models don't cover them. Storage with an inventory port, treatment with treated, residual and cost ports, and a temporal link all have no equivalent.
- **Time-indexed allocation:** the case needs multi-period decisions with inventory carried between periods (`next_period_inventory`). It also needs an optimization objective (`operational_dispatch`) over pipeline and trucking choices. This version only solves steady-state flowsheets. `validate_revision` also refuses the optimization task.
- **Components and property packages:** the case defines none, so there is nothing to map to a component set or property method.

I made no commits and submitted no jobs.

This OpenFlowsheet version offers only generic steady-state units (mixers, splitters, heaters, flashes, pumps, valves, reactors, feed sources and product sinks). It has no pad, transport, storage-tank, water-treatment, temporal-link or objective units. It cannot represent multi-period inventory or optimization, and it refuses the optimization task. Nothing was built, to avoid substituting different units."}, "claims": []}
